# Three.js

Vendored from the official npm package `three@0.180.0`:
https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

Included unchanged: `build/three.module.js`, `build/three.core.js`,
`examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js` and the MIT `LICENSE`.

The import map in `index.html` resolves `three` locally. No CDN, build step or
network dependency is required at runtime. Update these four files together.
